title: Commercial Credit Account Billing Preferences and the Monthly Paper Invoice Fee
content:
Invoices on a Commercial Credit Account are delivered by email unless the account elects paper or EDI.

### Elections

1. Monthly consolidated billing or EDI delivery is set only on a tier that offers consolidated billing or EDI invoicing respectively; the account's terms tier in the system record decides.
2. A change of billing cycle takes effect from the first day of the next calendar month; invoices already posted keep their dates and due dates.

### Paper invoice fee

3. When the account's invoice delivery is paper, a paper invoice fee of the tier's per-invoice amount is assessed once per billing month for every invoice mailed, dated the last calendar day of that month; a tier whose paper invoice fee is 0.00 is not charged.
4. The monthly fee is the number of invoices posted with an invoice date in that month while the account's delivery is paper, multiplied by the tier's paper invoice fee.

### Q&A

**A customer on per-shipment billing elects consolidated billing mid-month. When does it apply?** From the first day of the next calendar month; invoices already posted keep their dates and due dates.

**Hypothetical fee:** 7 paper invoices in a month at 2.50 each give a fee of 17.50, dated the last day of that month.
